items: computeSmoothNormals: Computes area-weighted smooth vertex normals for any triangular index mesh.
generateTubeMesh: Sweeps a 3D tube along an arbitrary curve using the Bishop (Parallel Transport) Frame. Prevents gimbal lock, twisting, and flipping along loops and knots.
generateCapsuleMesh: Generates a continuous, seam-free 3D Capsule (Pill) mesh.
generateRoundedBoxMesh: Generates an accurate Rounded Box 3D mesh with filleted edges and spherical corners.
generatePrismMesh: Generates an extruded regular N-gon Prism 3D mesh.
generatePyramidMesh: Generates an N-sided base Pyramid 3D mesh.
generatePlatonicMesh: Generates Platonic solids (Tetrahedron, Octahedron, Dodecahedron, Icosahedron).
generateTorusKnotMesh: Generates a mathematical (p, q) Torus Knot 3D mesh.
generateHelixMesh: Generates a smooth 3D Helical Coil / Spring mesh.
generateTubeCylinderMesh: Generates a Hollow Cylindrical Tube / Pipe 3D mesh with wall thickness.
generateEllipsoidMesh: Generates an Ellipsoid 3D mesh with independent X, Y, Z semi-axes and analytical normals.
generateGear3DMesh: Generates an extruded 3D Mechanical Spur Gear mesh.
generateTruncatedConeMesh: Generates a Truncated Cone (Frustum) 3D mesh.
generateWedgeMesh: Generates a 3D Wedge (Right-Angled Ramp) mesh.
generateBipyramidMesh: Generates an N-sided 3D Bipyramid (dipyramid) mesh with symmetrical or distinct top/bottom apices.
generateDiamond3DMesh: Generates a faceted 3D Diamond / Gemstone mesh with customizable facets, crown, table, girdle, and pavilion.
generateSuperellipsoidMesh: Generates a 3D Superellipsoid (Superquadric) parametric mesh. Smoothly morphs between sphere, cube, cylinder, diamond star, and pillow via exponents e1 & e2.

cells: normalizeVec: function normalizeVec(x: number, y: number, z: number): [number, number, number]
Implementation: `const len = Math.hypot(x, y, z) || 1; return [x / len, y / len, z / len];`.

items: buildFilletedPolygon: Builds an SVG path string for a closed polygon with individual or uniform rounded corner fillets. Uses exact tangent circular arc fillets (G1 continuous).
buildFilletedStar: Builds an SVG path string for an N-pointed star with optional independent outer and inner corner rounding.
generateSuperellipsePoints: Generates superellipse (Lamé curve) points: |x/a|^n + |y/b|^n = 1.

buildHeartPath: Builds an SVG path string for a mathematical cardioid / heart shape. Features mathematically continuous (C1) cubic Bézier lobes, smooth circular crests, and a crisp bottom tip without any pinched horn or loop artifacts.
buildCrossPath: Builds an SVG path string for a symmetrical or Greek/Swiss cross with filleted corners.
buildGearPath: Builds an SVG path string for a mechanical spur gear with customizable teeth, root radius, pitch radius, outer addendum, tooth slant, and optional center bore hole.
buildTeardropPath: Builds an SVG path string for a sleek teardrop / map marker / fluid drop shape.
buildAnnulusPath: Builds an SVG path string for an annulus (ring / donut) or annular sector.
buildSectorPath: Builds an SVG path string for a circular sector (pie slice).

buildCurvedArrowPath: Builds an SVG path string for a curved arrow sweeping along a circular arc with tangent-aligned arrowheads. If thickness > 0, generates a solid closed ribbon arrow polygon that can be filled and stroked cleanly.
buildChevronPath: Builds an SVG path string for a chevron (V-arrow stripe).
buildArchitecturalProfilePath: Builds an SVG path string for an architectural structural profile (I, H, T, L, C).
buildSpiralPath: Builds an SVG path string for a 2D spiral (Archimedean or Logarithmic).
buildWaveformPath: Builds an SVG path string for a periodic waveform (sine, triangle, square, sawtooth).
buildDiamondPath: Builds an SVG path string for a symmetrical or diamond (rhombus / lozenge) shape with optional rounded corner fillets.
buildTrapezoidPath: Builds an SVG path string for an isosceles or skewed trapezoid with optional rounded corner fillets.
buildParallelogramPath: Builds an SVG path string for a parallelogram with configurable slant skew and rounded corner fillets.
buildCrescentPath: Builds an SVG path string for a crescent / moon shape formed by the intersection of two circular arcs.
